judicial_precedents_coverage.case: Shreya Singhal v. Union of India
judicial_precedents_coverage.subject: Section 66A struck down as unconstitutional; Section 79(3)(b) read down to require court order or government notification.

judicial_precedents_coverage.case: Arjun Panditrao Khotkar v. Kailash Kushanrao Gorantyal
judicial_precedents_coverage.subject: Section 65B(4) certificate mandatory for secondary electronic evidence; Shafhi Mohammad overruled.

judicial_precedents_coverage.case: Anvar P.V. v. P.K. Basheer and Others
judicial_precedents_coverage.subject: Special provisions of Section 65A/65B exclude general secondary evidence rules; Navjot Sandhu overruled.

judicial_precedents_coverage.case: Smt. Selvi & Ors. v. State of Karnataka
judicial_precedents_coverage.subject: Involuntary narco-analysis, polygraph, and BEAP brain mapping violate Article 20(3) and 21; digital mental privacy.

judicial_precedents_coverage.case: Justice K.S. Puttaswamy (Retd.) v. Union of India
judicial_precedents_coverage.court: Supreme Court of India (9-Judge Constitution Bench)
judicial_precedents_coverage.subject: Fundamental right to privacy under Article 21 encompasses informational privacy and digital communications.

judicial_precedents_coverage.case: Google India Pvt Ltd v. Visaka Industries
judicial_precedents_coverage.subject: Pre-2008 intermediary liability did not grant blanket immunity for criminal defamation under IPC.

judicial_precedents_coverage.case: Christian Louboutin SAS v. Nakul Bajaj
judicial_precedents_coverage.subject: Active e-commerce platforms lose Section 79 safe harbor immunity for trademark counterfeiting.
